source.notes: Companion follow-up to csrf-required-403 (071): GET /sap/bc/adt/programs/programs/zmcp_csrf_probe run immediately after the rejected create. Returns 404 ExceptionResourceNotFound ('ZMCP_CSRF_PROBE does not exist'), confirming the CSRF-rejected write in 071 genuinely had no side effect — the program was never created. Strengthens the csrf-required-403 scenario. Authorization/set-cookie header values were already redacted at the source (placeholders preserved as-is).
